en: The postcard features a colorized image of a large statue of Martin Luther standing on a pedestal, with his right hand raised. The statue is situated in a fenced park-like area, featuring young trees and a gate in the foreground. The surroundings look rural or suburban, and the sky is lightly colored, suggesting either dawn or dusk. There is text in both German and Estonian at the top, identifying the monument and the location.
